items.titleZh: 凯迪拉克选择博塔斯留队，赫塔获2027年储备车手邀约
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队确认博塔斯将在下赛季继续与佩雷兹搭档，并向感到失望的赫塔提供了2027年储备车手角色。赫塔此前已在巴西大奖赛完成足够里程以获得F1超级驾照，但下赛季无缘正式车手席位。
items.originalTitle: What next for Herta after 'disappointing' Bottas 2027 decision
items.summaryEn: The Cadillac Formula 1 team has confirmed that Valtteri Bottas will continue alongside Sergio Perez next season and has offered a "disappointed" Colton Herta a reserve driver role for 2027. Herta had secured enough mileage to obtain an F1 superlicence at the Brazilian Grand Prix but will not turn that into a race seat next season.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队已向感到“失望”的科尔顿·赫塔提供了2027年储备车手角色，此前车队选择让瓦尔特利·博塔斯下赛季继续为车队比赛。
凯迪拉克在2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛前确认博塔斯将至少再留一个赛季、继续担任塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹的队友，从而结束了赫塔可能取代博塔斯的猜测。
博塔斯原本已有合同在身，但在博塔斯经历了一个常常难以与佩雷兹匹敌的艰难赛季后，凯迪拉克此前拒绝平息有关博塔斯可能被买断并由赫塔接替的猜测。
赫塔此前一直在积累足够里程以取得F1超级驾照，这一任务最终在11月早些时候的巴西大奖赛上完成，但如今这一努力不会在下赛季转化为F1正式车手席位。
在拉斯维加斯大奖赛期间，凯迪拉克车队所有者TWG Motorsports的首席执行官丹·托里斯表示，赫塔对车队不得不做出的这个“艰难决定”感到“失望”。
“这绝对是一个艰难的决定，与科尔顿进行了一次艰难的讨论，”托里斯说，“我认为他很失望。为了走到这一步，付出了很多努力，也有很多积累。”
“很明显，今年科尔顿在F2中经历了一个非常艰难的赛季，但他在第一节自由练习和旧车测试（TPC）环境中所做的工作相当扎实，表明他确实有能力驾驶这辆赛车。
“但当我们审视车队目前的状况以及车队所需时，博塔斯是面向未来的最佳选择。
“但我们会继续和科尔顿讨论目前摆在桌面上的各种选择，并再给一点时间，因为我认为他对没能得到那个机会感到失望。”
赫塔在F2的成绩并不理想——最好排位赛成绩为第三，在巴塞罗那获得第五名，但除此之外大多在排位赛和正赛中远离前十——不过这些成绩应当放在一位来自印地赛车的车手必须迅速适应一个完全陌生且水平极高的欧洲赛车环境的背景下来看待。他为凯迪拉克出战的六次第一节自由练习（FP1）表现也并不惊艳。
如今一些车手在F1测试中的表现远比他们在F2中能展现出来的更令人印象深刻，这并不罕见；而像凯迪拉克这样一支全新的车队虽然没有自己的测试旧车项目，却能够通过其他车队（包括阿尔派）借出的旧车来评估赫塔，看起来赫塔在那样的环境中表现得更令人印象深刻。
但还不足以令人印象深刻到把博塔斯挤出比赛席位，因此赫塔将需要选择是否接受凯迪拉克的最新报价，并耐心等待到2028年。
“我们已经给了他一个储备车手的位置。2028年的席位是开放的。所以对科尔顿来说，桌面上有多个选择，”托里斯确认道。“其他（摩托）运动领域也有选择。”
“我认为他已经决定了一个方向，但我们仍在就此进行沟通，并期待看到科尔顿想做什么。”
托里斯基本上还确认了车队正在认真评估在2027年替换博塔斯，但认定他在2026年与佩雷斯的赛车表现差距有足够部分“不在他的控制范围内”，因此不足以构成终止合同的理由。
“我们确实想审视一下，”托里斯在谈到对博塔斯位置的疑虑时说。“当我们纵观各场比赛时，虽然练习赛和排位赛与佩雷斯相似，但正赛速度下降了。
其中一些是瓦尔特里无法控制的幕后因素。我们确实想研究一下这一点。
我们也在努力让科尔顿·赫塔做好准备。我们车队有一位美国车手参赛很重要。但最终，当我们审视之后，瓦尔特里才是合适的人选。
我们希望让佩雷兹和瓦尔特里继续搭档，他们的经验、连续性以及他们为车队带来的东西。
最终，这对车队来说是正确的决定，我们很高兴与瓦尔特里续约。他对我们来说绝对非常出色。
detailEn: The Cadillac Formula 1 team has offered a "disappointed" Colton Herta a reserve driver role for 2027, after choosing Valtteri Bottas to continue racing for the team next season.
Cadillac ended speculation that Herta could replace Bottas by confirming ahead of the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix that Bottas would remain Sergio Perez's team-mate for at least one more season.
Bottas was already under contract, but Cadillac refused to dampen speculation Bottas could be paid off and replaced by Herta after a tough season in which Bottas has often struggled to match Perez.

Herta was building up enough mileage to secure an F1 superlicence, a mission that was finally accomplished at the Brazilian Grand Prix, earlier in November, but now won't see that quest turn into an F1 race seat next season.
Speaking at the Las Vegas GP, Dan Towriss, CEO of Cadillac team owner TWG Motorsports, said Herta was "disappointed" with what had been a "tough decision" for the team to make.
"It was definitely a tough decision, a tough discussion with Colton," Towriss said "I think he was disappointed. There was a lot of work, a lot of build-up going to this.

"It was obvious it was a very tough season for Colton in F2 this year, but then work that he did in FP1s and the TPC [Testing of Previous Cars] setting were quite strong and showed that he really is capable of driving this car.
"But when we look at where the team is right now and what's needed for the team, Valtteri was the best decision going forward.
"But we're going to continue to talk to Colton about the options that are on the table and give it a little bit of time because I think he is disappointed to not have that opportunity."

Herta's F2 results have been poor - a best qualifying of third and a fifth placed finish at Barcelona but otherwise mostly qualifying and racing well outside the top 10 - but those results should be taken in the context of a driver from IndyCar having to rapidly adapt to an unfamiliar European racing scene at a very high level. His six FP1 outings for Cadillac haven't been stunning either.

It's not uncommon now for some drivers to be much more impressive in F1 test running than they can show in F2, and although a brand new team like Cadillac doesn't have its own TPC programme, it has been able to evaluate Herta in old cars loaned by other teams, including Alpine, and it would seem Herta has been more impressive in that setting.
But not impressive enough to force Bottas out of a race seat, and so Herta will need to choose whether to accept Cadillac's latest offer and bide his time until 2028.
"We've offered him a reserve position. The seat's open for 2028. So there are options on the table for Colton," Towriss confirmed. "There are options in other [motor]sports as well.
"I think he's decided on a direction, but we're still in conversations on that and look forward to seeing what Colton wants to do."

Towriss essentially also confirmed the team was seriously evaluating replacing Bottas for 2027, but determined that enough of his race performance discrepancy to Perez in 2026 had been "out of his control" to not warrant a contract termination.
"We did want to take a look at it," said Towriss of the doubt over Bottas's position. "As we looked across the races, while practice and qualifying was similar to Checo, race pace was down.
"Some of that is things behind the scenes that are out of Valtteri's control. We did want to take a look at that.
"We were working hard to get Colton Herta ready as well. It's important to have an American driver with our team racing. But ultimately, when we took a look at it, Valtteri's the right guy.
"We want to keep Checo and Valtteri together, their experience, the continuity, what they bring to the team.
"Ultimately, it was the right decision for the team and we were happy to extend Valtteri. He's been absolutely fantastic for us."

博塔斯原本已有合同，但车队此前未排除其被买断后由赫塔接替的可能。

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔在湿滑的拉斯维加斯大奖赛第二场自由练习中险些被阿尔派和加斯利超越
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛第二场自由练习中险些被阿尔派和加斯利超越。尽管赛道湿滑，但比赛条件比第一场练习要好得多。
items.originalTitle: Russell denies Alpine and Gasly top spot in wet Las Vegas GP FP2
detailZh: 梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛第二场自由练习中险些被阿尔派和加斯利超越。
尽管赛道湿滑，但比赛条件比第一场练习要好得多。
兰多·诺里斯在练习三分之一的时间内从湿胎切换到中间胎，随着赛道逐渐干燥，时间也在不断下降。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔在大部分时间里领跑法拉利，但最终被拉塞尔在最后几秒以1m47.272s的圈速超越。
加斯利在飞驰过前两个赛段时看起来有机会击败梅赛德斯，但一次大的转向失误让他落后了0.071秒，未能获得第一名。
勒克莱尔保持第三名，红牛车队的伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，他在最后一圈遇到了他所说的“完全迷失”的奥利·贝尔曼的哈斯赛车，这让他失去了位置。
早先的领跑者诺里斯最终排名第七，领先冠军安东内利一名。
维斯塔潘的练习非常奇特。他在红牛车队的维修区里坐了大部分时间，只完成了九圈，这是所有人中最少的。
当他终于在最后几分钟出来进行第一次正式的跑圈时，他抱怨说没有"动力"。工程师Gianpiero Lambiase建议红牛的引擎只需要升温，但维斯塔潘坚决反驳说"这不是正常的"。
他在结束一小时的比赛后仅排名第13，通过车队无线电抱怨说赛车"不好"，并且有和他两周前在巴西大奖赛练习中报告的"相同"问题。
尽管天气预报显示整个赛事的天气将保持干燥，但周四的条件从未干燥到足以使用光头胎。
勒克莱尔提出了尝试光头胎的想法，但被法拉利劝阻，而拉塞尔在梅赛德斯询问他对赛道条件的看法时回应说"如果你在问光头胎，没门，约瑟夫"。
尽管路面湿滑，但唯一的事故只是轻微的跑偏或打滑，唯一的一次红旗是因为一块大的塑料包装物被风吹到赛道上，被拉塞尔·斯特罗尔的阿斯顿·马丁车队收集。
加斯利是唯一一个最终在成绩单上占据引人注目位置的黑马，但阿斯顿·马丁车队当天排名第10和第11，以及塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯驾驶的凯迪拉克排名第14，都是相当引人注目的成绩。
detailEn: Mercedes' George Russell narrowly denied Pierre Gasly and Alpine an upset result in second practice for Formula 1's Las Vegas Grand Prix.

Conditions remained wet for Thursday night's second session but were much more amenable than they had been in the puddle-strewn practice one in which no one even tried a flying lap and the most laps any driver completed was two.
Lando Norris led a move from wet to intermediate tyres a third of the way into the session, and times kept falling as the track kept drying through to the end.
Charles Leclerc topped much of the running for Ferrari, but was usurped in the final seconds by Russell's 1m47.272s lap.
Gasly looked like he had a shot at toppling the Mercedes as he flew through the first two sectors, before a big oversteer slide cost him enough that he fell 0.071 seconds short of first place.

Leclerc remained third, with Isack Hadjar fourth for Red Bull having lost a late lap when he came across what he described as the "completely lost" Ollie Bearman's Haas running slowly in front of him.
Early pacesetter Norris fell to seventh for McLaren by the end, one place ahead of champion Kimi Antonelli.
Max Verstappen had a curious session. He sat out much of the hour in the Red Bull garage, completing only nine laps - the least of anyone.

When he did come out for his first proper run in the closing minutes, he complained of having "no power". Engineer Gianpiero Lambiase suggested the Red Bull's engine just need to come up to temperature, but Verstappen refuted that with a firm "this is not normal".
Having ended the hour only 13th, he complained over team radio that the car was "not good" and had the "same" problems as he'd reported in Brazilian GP practice a fortnight ago.
Though the weather is forecast to be dry for the rest of the event, conditions never dried enough for slicks on Thursday.
Leclerc floated the idea of trying them but was discouraged by Ferrari, while Russell responded "if you're asking about slicks, no way Jose" when Mercedes asked for his thoughts on track conditions.

Despite the slippery surface, the only incidents were minor runoff area visits or spins, and the only red flag was caused when a large piece of plastic packaging blew onto the track and was collected by Lance Stroll's Aston Martin.

Gasly was the only underdog to end up in a truly eye-catching place on the timesheets, but Aston Martin finishing the day 10th and 11th and Sergio Perez's Cadillac 14th were reasonably notable results.

keyPointsEn: Charles Leclerc led most of the Ferrari's running but was overtaken by Russell in the final seconds

items.titleZh: 在拉斯维加斯观看F1赛车无需门票
items.summaryZh: 本周在拉斯维加斯，您无需购买看台票也能近距离接触F1赛车。车队、合作伙伴和度假村在拉斯维加斯大奖赛期间在拉斯维加斯大道上停放展示车和复制品，大部分都可以免费参观。

items.originalTitle: Where to see F1 cars in Las Vegas without a race ticket
detailZh: 在哪里可以看到拉斯维加斯的F1赛车而不需要比赛门票
从贝拉吉奥的梅赛德斯到街头服饰店里的麦凯轮，这里是拉斯维加斯大奖赛周期间在拉斯维加斯大道上找到一级方程式赛车的地方
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
在这个星期，你不需要看台座位就能在拉斯维加斯接近一级方程式赛车。
车队、合作伙伴和度假村在拉斯维加斯大奖赛的赛道上停放展示了赛车和复制品，其中大部分对游客免费开放。这里是它们的所在地。
世界冠军车队拥有最大的展区。贝拉吉奥主入口处的梅赛德斯粉丝中心有一个2026年的展示赛车、赛车模拟器和在真实F1赛车上的维修区挑战，由车队技术人员提供。它从下午2点开放到晚上10点，直到周六。
梅赛德斯，凯撒宫论坛购物中心
第二个梅赛德斯展区位于论坛购物中心内，那里停放着一辆官方W17复制品，直到周日它都停放在IWC沙夫豪森精品店外。
麦凯轮，文化王者在论坛购物中心
在同一商场，一辆麦凯轮赛车在街头服饰店Culture Kings展出，该店曾与麦凯轮合作举办赛车周活动。
在大道北端，红牛将一辆Oracle 红牛 Racing复制品赛车带到了Resorts World，并配备了两个从下午2点到晚上8点开放的模拟器。在威尼拉斯，粉丝还可以在威尼拉斯赛车汽车休息室挑战红牛维修区。
纽约-纽约桥上的威廉姆斯粉丝区有一个全尺寸的FW48展示赛车，以及模拟器。它从上午11点到晚上7点开放，直到周六，粉丝需要通过威廉姆斯应用程序进行注册。
威尼斯人酒店是阿尔法罗密欧车队酒店，一辆阿尔法罗密欧一级方程式赛车在酒店大柱廊展出，靠近大堂。
哈斯赛车和车队纪念品在科斯莫波利坦酒店的切尔西塔2层全天展出，直到周日。
Fontainebleau酒店在其北大堂有自己的定制赛车，展出至周六。
为了有所不同，乐高将为周六比赛前的每支车队提供一辆可驾驶的乐高一级方程式迷你赛车，在赛道上绕一圈。乐高还装饰了一辆拉斯维加斯单轨列车，并接管了 flamingo/Caesars Palace车站。
法拉利车迷们将不得不满足于贝拉吉奥的法拉利精品店，那里正在出售赛车周服装，以及威尼斯的Cafe 勒克莱尔。
Grand Prix Plaza，这个全年都有的F1景点，通常展示包括埃尔顿·塞纳的Lotus 99T在内的历史赛车，在赛车周期间关闭，并于1月8日重新开放。
detailEn: Where to see F1 cars in Las Vegas without a race ticket
From Mercedes at Bellagio to a McLaren in a streetwear store, here is where to find Formula 1 cars around the Strip during Las Vegas Grand Prix week
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
You do not need a grandstand seat to get close to a Formula 1 car in Las Vegas this week.
Teams, partners and resorts have parked show cars and replicas all over the Strip for the Las Vegas Grand Prix, and most of them are free to visit. Here is where to find them.

The world champions have the biggest set-up. The Mercedes Fan Hub in Bellagio's main porte cochere has a 2026 show car, racing simulators and a pit stop challenge on a real F1 car with team mechanics. It is open from 2pm to 10pm until Saturday.
Mercedes, The Forum Shops at Caesars Palace
A second Mercedes stop sits inside The Forum Shops, where an official replica of the W17 is parked outside the IWC Schaffhausen boutique until Sunday.
McLaren, Culture Kings at The Forum Shops
In the same mall, a McLaren car is on display at streetwear store Culture Kings, which has partnered with McLaren for race week in previous years.

At the north end of the Strip, Red Bull has brought an Oracle Red Bull Racing replica car to Resorts World, along with two simulators that are open from 2pm to 8pm until Saturday. Over at Wynn, fans can also take on a Red Bull pit stop challenge in the Wynn Racing Motors Lounge.

The Williams Fan Zone on New York-New York's Brooklyn Bridge has a full-size FW48 show car, plus simulators. It is open from 11am to 7pm until Saturday, and fans need to register through the Williams app.
The Venetian is Alpine's team hotel, and an Alpine F1 car is on display in the Grand Colonnade, near the lobby.
A Haas race car and team memorabilia are on display around the clock on Level 2 of The Cosmopolitan's Chelsea Tower until Sunday.
Fontainebleau has its own custom race car in its North Lobby until Saturday.

For something different, LEGO will send a drivable LEGO F1 minicar for each of the 11 teams on a lap of the circuit ahead of Saturday's race. LEGO has also wrapped a Las Vegas Monorail train and taken over the Flamingo/Caesars Palace station.
Ferrari fans will have to make do with the Ferrari Boutique at Bellagio, which is selling race-week clothing, and Cafe Leclerc at Wynn.
Grand Prix Plaza, the year-round F1 attraction that usually displays historic cars including Ayrton Senna's Lotus 99T, is closed for race week and reopens on 8 January.

detailZh: 五位车手因引擎更换将在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛中获得发车位处罚
基米·安东内利、奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂、奥利弗·贝尔曼、卡洛斯·塞恩斯和兰斯·斯特罗尔都将在拉斯维加斯大奖赛中受到F1发车位处罚
五名车手将在拉斯维加斯大奖赛中受到发车位处罚，包括新晋的F1世界冠军基米·安东内利
正如梅赛德斯之前所指示的，安东内利因更换内燃机将受到五位发车位下降的处罚——但由于仍在他的配额内，因此不会因涡轮增压器更换而受到额外的处罚。
梅赛德斯宣布2026年F1世界冠军将采用其升级的涡轮规格，这是根据ADUO允许的，而拉塞尔将坚持使用当前规格，因为他需要服刑更大的发车网格处罚，这是由于他超过了他的配额。
麦克拉伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂将为引擎更换而受到10个位置的网格处罚，这是车队之前所指示的，而卡洛斯·塞恩斯也将受到10个位置的处罚，因为威廉姆斯车队选择给他本季第五个涡轮增压器。
与安东内利一样，皮亚斯蒂和他的队友兰多·诺里斯都将配备升级版的梅赛德斯涡轮增压器。
奥利弗·贝尔曼将因为几乎整个动力单元更换而受到发车网格后部的处罚，包括他的第五个内燃机、第五个涡轮增压器、第五个排气系统和第五个MGU-K，这将总计35个位置的处罚。
最后，在巴西站上，由于搭载本田引擎的阿斯顿·马丁赛车在最新一次比赛中因电池问题退赛，斯特罗尔将在拉斯维加斯获得第九个新的能源存储和第八个新的控制电子设备。加拿大车手将因这两项更换总共受到10个位置的发车处罚。
detailEn: Five drivers set for grid penalties for engine changes at F1 Las Vegas GP
Kimi Antonelli, Oscar Piastri, Oliver Bearman, Carlos Sainz and Lance Stroll will all take F1 grid penalties into the Las Vegas GP
Five drivers will take grid penalties for the Las Vegas Grand Prix, including new Formula 1 world champion Kimi Antonelli.

As previously indicated by Mercedes, Antonelli will take a five-place grid drop for an internal combustion engine change – but does not pick up a further penalty for a turbocharger change due to still being within his allocation.

Mercedes announced the 2026 F1 world champion would take on its upgraded turbo specification as permitted under ADUO, while Russell would stick with the current specification due to needing to serve a greater grid penalty for exceeding his allocation.

McLaren’s Oscar Piastri will serve a 10-place grid penalty for an engine change – as previously indicated by the team – while Carlos Sainz will also serve a 10-place penalty after Williams opted to give him his fifth turbocharger of the season.
Like Antonelli, both Piastri and team-mate Lando Norris will be equipped with the upgraded Mercedes turbo.

Oliver Bearman will serve a back of the grid penalty for an almost entire power unit change – including his fifth internal combustion engine, fifth turbocharger, fifth exhaust and fifth MGU-K – which would tally up to 35 places in total.

Finally, Lance Stroll will take a ninth new energy store and an eight new control electronics in Las Vegas after his Honda-powered Aston Martin suffered its latest battery-related retirement last time out in Brazil. The Canadian will serve a 10-place grid penalty in total for the two changes.
keyPointsZh: 安东内利是新的F1世界冠军
keyPointsEn: Antonelli is the new Formula 1 world champion

items.originalTitle: At least five drivers carrying grid penalties at F1's Las Vegas GP
detailZh: 包括2026年世界冠军基米·安东内利在内的至少五名车手将在拉斯维加斯大奖赛中受到发车处罚。
到目前为止，大多数宣布的处罚与车手使用梅赛德斯为此次赛事提供的升级动力单元组件有关。
梅赛德斯六辆车中的五辆将进行升级 - 包括改进的涡轮增压器，但预计不会带来特别大的性能提升。
目前只有梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔坚持使用之前的规格。
引擎更换导致麦克拉伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和威廉姆斯的卡洛斯·塞恩斯分别受到10位次的处罚，而安东内利由于动力单元组件的使用，受到5位次的处罚。
阿尔皮斯车队以及塞恩斯和皮亚斯特里的各自队友亚历克斯·阿隆和兰多·诺里斯可以安装升级而不受处罚。
在梅赛德斯车队之外，哈斯-法拉利的奥利·贝尔曼将因为更换大量新引擎部件而排在发车网格的最后，而阿斯顿·马丁-本田的车手兰斯·斯特罗尔因更换新的能源存储和控制电子设备而受到10位次的处罚。
detailEn: At least five drivers, including 2026 world champion Kimi Antonelli, will take grid penalties for Formula 1's Las Vegas Grand Prix.

The majority of those declared so far are related to drivers taking the updated power unit components Mercedes has made available for this event under its Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities allowance.
Five of its six cars are taking the upgrade - which includes a modified turbocharger, but which is not expected to be a particularly large outright performance gain.
Only Mercedes works driver George Russell is sticking with the previous specification for now.
The engine change triggers 10-place penalties for McLaren's Oscar Piastri and Williams's Carlos Sainz and a five-place penalty for Antonelli, based on their power unit component usage so far.
The Alpines, and Sainz and Piastri's respective team-mates, Alex Albon and Lando Norris, can fit the upgrade without incurring penalties.

Outside the Mercedes contingent, Haas-Ferrari driver Ollie Bearman will be right at the back of the grid as he takes a substantial number of new engine parts, and Aston Martin-Honda's Lance Stroll incurs a 10-place penalty for taking a new energy store and control electronics.
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯六辆车中的五辆将进行升级，包括改进的涡轮增压器
keyPointsEn: Five of Mercedes' six cars will undergo the upgrade, including a modified turbocharger

items.originalTitle: Cadillac scraps V6 F1 engine, delays entry as PU manufacturer
detailZh: 凯迪拉克放弃V6一级方程式引擎，推迟进入作为动力单元制造商
首席执行官丹·托里斯表示，凯迪拉克将作为法拉利的客户车队再保持一年。通用汽车推迟其自身一级方程式动力单元的引入，直到2030年V8引擎的到来
凯迪拉克计划将其内部一级方程式动力单元的引入推迟一年，至2030年
美国车队最初的计划是在2029年首次使用通用汽车的动力单元参加锦标赛。然而，这是基于当前法规周期将完整运行的假设，以及下一代动力单元将不会在2031年引入的想法
这种情况已经发生了变化。在拉斯维加斯大奖赛之前，车队和制造商原则上达成了一致，提前恢复V8引擎的回归，正如麦凯轮首席执行官Zak Brown在周四的团队负责人新闻发布会上公开确认的那样。
阿尔卑斯车队负责人Flavio Briatore补充说，签名尚未落笔，但已经就2030年采用2.1升涡轮增压V8引擎并减少电力比例达成一致。
这一发展对通用汽车的计划产生了影响。如果美国制造商打算最早在2029年将凯迪拉克转变为官方车队，通用汽车将不得不开发符合当前规格的动力单元，仅用于一个赛季。这将是一项昂贵的举措。
当Motorsport.com询问是否因此继续作为客户车队再待一个赛季更有意义时，丹·托里斯CEO在拉斯维加斯确认说：“是的，我们将继续在2029年成为法拉利的客户，并在2030年使用V8引擎推出凯迪拉克动力单元。”
托里斯认为V8的到来对这项运动是一个积极的进步，也是凯迪拉克支持的方向。
“是的，我的意思是，我们很高兴看到这个系列赛在FIA的领导下真正团结起来，为2030年的V8设定方向。我们对此感到非常高兴，”托里斯说。
他还补充说，凯迪拉克和通用汽车正接近另一个里程碑。不到一个月的时间，他们在北卡罗来纳州夏洛特的专用动力单元设施将开业。
“是的，我们的新动力单元设施将于12月18日开业。作为一个新进入这项运动的制造商，有这个方向显然非常有帮助。我们对这个方向感到兴奋，并且我们的团队正在努力准备。”
除了预期会更能吸引粉丝外，V8引擎还旨在更加简单和便宜，这对新来者来说也是好消息。
当设施开始运营时，凯迪拉克最初仍然会在V6和V8设计上同时工作，尽管当前动力单元的2029年版本将不再需要完全开发。
“嗯，在一段时间内，我们同时在开发两者。所以他们已经有一个V6的基础可以在此基础上构建，然后我们再向V8努力，”托里斯解释道。
现在有多个设计正在进行中，所以我们有很好的基础来构建我们正在尝试的东西，以及我们前进的方向。
这应该会导致凯迪拉克在2030年推出其首个内部动力单元，正式将这位美国新来者打造成一支工厂车队。这个长期目标对于确保其F1参赛资格的批准也至关重要，因为其他车队认为这是整个F1增加价值的主要来源。
detailEn: Cadillac scraps V6 F1 engine, delays entry as PU manufacturer
CEO Dan Towriss says Cadillac will remain a Ferrari customer team for another year. General Motors has postponed the introduction of its own F1 power unit until the arrival of the V8 in 2030
Cadillac is set to delay the introduction of its in-house Formula 1 power unit by a year to 2030.

The American squad's initial plan was to compete in the championship with its own General Motors power unit for the first time in 2029. However, that was based on the idea that the current regulations cycle would run its full course and that the next generation of power units would not be introduced until 2031.

That situation has since changed. Ahead of the Las Vegas Grand Prix, the teams and manufacturers reached an agreement in principle on bringing forward the return of V8 engines, as the McLaren CEO Zak Brown also publicly confirmed during the team principals' press conference on Thursday.

The signatures have not yet been put on paper, as Alpine team principal Flavio Briatore added, but an agreement has been reached on a 2.1-litre turbocharged V8 with a reduced proportion of electrical power from 2030.

This development has implications for General Motors' plans. If the American manufacturer were to press ahead with its intention to turn Cadillac into a works team as early as 2029, GM would have to develop a power unit to the current specifications for just a single season. That would be a costly undertaking.

Asked by Motorsport.com whether it would therefore make more sense to continue as a customer team for an extra season, CEO Dan Towriss confirmed in Las Vegas: "Yes, we would remain a customer of Ferrari through 2029 and bring the Cadillac power unit online in 2030 with the V8."
Towriss sees the arrival of the V8 as a positive development for the sport, and one that Cadillac supports.
"Yeah, I mean, I think we're glad to see really the series coming together under the leadership of the FIA to set that direction for a V8 in 2030. We're super happy with that," Towriss said.
He added that Cadillac and General Motors are approaching another milestone. In less than a month's time, their dedicated power unit facility in Charlotte, North Carolina, will open.

"Yes, our new power unit facility opens up on December 18th. So as a new manufacturer coming into the sport, having this direction is obviously very helpful. We're excited about the direction and the crew's hard at work getting ready."
Besides being expected to appeal more to fans, the V8 is also intended to be simpler and cheaper, which is likewise good news for a newcomer.

When the facility begins operations, Cadillac will initially still be working on both V6 and V8 designs, although the current generation of power units will no longer need to be fully developed for 2029.
"Well, for a period of time, we're working on both. So they've already got a V6 base to build off of and then we’re working towards the V8," Towriss explained.
"There are a number of designs that are in motion now, so there's a lot of good foundation for what we're trying to build and the direction we're headed in."

This should lead to the introduction of Cadillac's first in-house power unit in 2030, officially making the American newcomer a works team. That long-term ambition was also important in securing approval for its F1 entry, as the other teams saw it as the main source of added value for F1 as a whole.

items.originalTitle: F1 Las Vegas GP: Rain impacts FP1 running
items.summaryEn: The first free practice session for the Las Vegas Grand Prix saw no meaningful running due to steady rainfall that made the track slippery. Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson, after sampling this year's rain tyres in Brazil, said the team would be in trouble if it rained at a track like Las Vegas.
detailZh: F1拉斯维加斯站：降雨影响一练
持续降雨使拉斯维加斯大奖赛赛道变得像溜冰场一样滑，一级方程式第一节自由练习中没有完成有意义的测试。
“如果我们在像拉斯维加斯这样的赛道上遇到降雨，说实话，我认为我们会陷入麻烦，”小红牛车手利亚姆·劳森在巴西试用今年的雨胎后预测道。
他的评论反映了围场内的普遍情绪，因为倍耐力轮胎难以升温，尤其是在这条位于赌城的6公里街道赛道这样低速弯多且温度极低的情况下。
劳森的话被证明是有先见之明的，因为周四上午内华达州的天空间歇性地放晴，而当地时间下午4点30分第一次练习赛开始前又下起了更多的雨。
由于周末剩余时间预计几乎没有降雨，这自然导致了一节缺乏动作的练习赛，让花了大价钱购买赛事高得令人咋舌的门票的车迷们只能转而去二十一点赌桌上寻找刺激。
在低抓地力的赛道上冒险驶出，面对近在咫尺的护墙，感觉也像是一场赌博。但仿佛至少有意给主场车迷一些交代，美国拥有的凯迪拉克车队的塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯率先勇敢地使用全雨胎完成了一个探索性单圈。随后哈斯车队的拉斐尔·卡马拉和平川亮也加入其中，后者代替奥利弗·贝尔曼完成了新秀第一次练习赛。
第二辆凯迪拉克——瓦尔特利·博塔斯的赛车也探索了这恶劣的条件，在他唯一的一圈中用一个巨大的甩尾庆祝了自己2027年的确认，表明这两支美国拥有的车队当然不能被指责没有出力。
当电视观众和那些热衷于分析圈速与长距离表现的人同样感到不满足时，第一次自由练习赛实际上成了全年最具画面感的时段之一。拉斯维加斯大道本就上镜，但雨水让整条长街更沉浸于霓虹色的倒影之中，那种色调亨特·S·汤普森大概也会认可。
“太棒了，这条长街真漂亮，”法拉利替补车手迪诺·贝加诺维奇在代替刘易斯·汉密尔顿出战该节练习时惊叹道。
“好好观光吧……不过这一圈我们要进维修区了，谢谢，”法拉利那边传来例行公事般的回复。
贝加诺维奇倒不妨好好享受，因为对这位瑞典裔波黑车手来说，一开始留在车库里根本不是选项。车队的四次强制性新秀第一次自由练习赛要计入，车手至少必须离开车库一次。
这解释了为什么三位新秀车手都退出了比赛，其中包括在阿斯顿·马丁车队顶替费尔南多·阿隆索出战的杰克·克劳福德，尽管他们会为这次难得的机会未能提供实际里程数而感到遗憾。
正如世界冠军基米·安东内利报告了水滑现象一样，几位更有经验的车手也险些撞墙。亚历克斯·阿尔本在长街尽头的11号弯直接冲了出去，而奥迪车队的尼科·霍肯伯格也在湿透的左弯锁死了轮胎。
“这几乎就像溜冰场一样，”红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘报告说，这位荷兰人在最好的时候也是街道赛道的冷静崇拜者。
最终，除了五名车手外，所有人都体验了这些条件，迈凯伦和小红牛车队的四辆赛车认为不值得一试，阿斯顿·马丁车队的兰斯·斯特罗尔也感觉不是特别有动力。
卡马拉以及阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利和弗兰科·科拉平托是仅有的三位两次驶出维修区的车手，其中这位阿根廷车手在直道上短暂失控，几乎重现了他在2024年代表威廉姆斯车队高速排位赛撞车时的场景。
为避免疑问，本次未记录任何圈速。
detailEn: F1 Las Vegas GP: Rain impacts FP1 running
With steady rainfall turning the Las Vegas Grand Prix track into an ice rink, no meaningful running was completed during the first session of Formula 1 free practice.
"If we're on a track like Vegas and it rains, honestly, I think we're in trouble," Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson predicted after sampling this year's rain tyres in Brazil.

His comments reflected the general mood in the paddock, as the Pirelli tyres are difficult to bring up to temperature, especially at a circuit with low cornering speeds and glacial temperatures like the 6km street circuit in the gambling haven.
Lawson's comments proved relevant as the heavens opened intermittently in Nevada on Thursday morning, and more rain arrived right before the start of FP1 at 4:30 pm local time.

With little rain expected for the remainder of the weekend, it naturally led to an action-starved session, leaving fans forking out the event's eye-watering ticket prices to look for action at the blackjack tables instead.

Venturing out on the low-grip surface, with the walls looming large, felt like a gamble, too. But as if intent on at least offering the home fans something, Sergio Perez of US-owned team Cadillac was first to brave the conditions on full wet tyres for an exploratory lap. He was later joined by the Haas duo of Rafael Camara and Ryo Hirakawa, the latter completing a rookie FP1 session in place of Oliver Bearman.

The second Cadillac of Valtteri Bottas also explored the inclement conditions, celebrating his 2027 confirmation with a huge tank-slapper on his one lap, showing the two US-owned teams certainly could not be accused of failing to chip in.

While TV audiences and punters intent on analysing lap times and long runs were also left wanting, FP1 actually became one of the most picturesque sessions of the year. Las Vegas Boulevard is photogenic at the best of times, but the rain further drowned the Strip in neon-tinted reflections, hues Hunter S. Thompson would have approved of.
"Amazing, it's a lovely Strip," gawked Ferrari reserve driver Dino Beganovic as he replaced Lewis Hamilton for the session.
"Enjoy the sightseeing... but we'll box this lap, please," came the perfunctory reply from Ferrari.

Beganovic may as well have enjoyed it, as staying tucked inside the garage was not an option to begin with for the Swedish-Bosnian driver. For any of the teams' four mandatory rookie FP1 sessions to count, drivers must at least leave the garage once.

It explains why all three rookie runners went out, including Jak Crawford, who deputised for Fernando Alonso at Aston Martin, though they will be ruing the lack of actual mileage the rare opportunity was able to provide.

As world champion Kimi Antonelli reported aquaplaning, several more experienced drivers had close shaves with the walls. Alex Albon went straight on at Turn 11 at the end of the Strip, while Audi's Nico Hulkenberg also locked up at the drenched left-hander.
"It's almost like an ice rink," reported Red Bull's Max Verstappen, the Dutchman a rather cool admirer of street circuits at the best of times.
Eventually, all but five drivers sampled the conditions, with the four cars from McLaren and Racing Bulls thinking better of it, and Aston's Lance Stroll also not feeling particularly motivated.

Camara and the Alpine duo of Pierre Gasly and Franco Colapinto were the only three drivers to venture out twice, with the Argentine nearly reliving the scenes of his high-speed qualifying shunt in 2024 for Williams as he momentarily lost control of his car on the straight.
For the avoidance of doubt, no lap times were recorded.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力雨胎难以升温，尤其在拉斯维加斯这条6公里街道赛道低速弯多且温度极低的情况下。
劳森的评论反映了围场内的普遍情绪。
keyPointsEn: Pirelli rain tyres are difficult to bring up to temperature, especially at the 6km street circuit in Las Vegas with its low cornering speeds and glacial temperatures.
Lawson's comments reflected the general mood in the paddock.

items.titleZh: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛FP1练习赛因大雨取消，无圈速记录
items.summaryZh: 由于大雨，周四晚上的第一场练习赛没有设置任何圈速。哈斯车队的新车手拉斐尔·卡马拉是唯一两次出场的车手，他和两辆阿尔皮斯车手共同完成了两圈。哈斯车队带来的独特后翼设计未能使用。
items.originalTitle: No times set at all in Las Vegas FP1 washout
detailZh: 大雨意味着周四晚上的拉斯维加斯大奖赛FP1练习赛以一种奇特的方式开始，第一场练习赛中没有设置任何圈速。
尽管17名车手身着全湿胎尝试了解赛道情况，但没有车手在积水、频繁的打滑和极低温度中尝试飞驰圈速。
只有哈斯车队的新车手拉斐尔·卡马拉两次出场，他和两辆阿尔皮斯车手在最后时刻共同完成了两圈。阿尔皮斯车手在最后时刻自行进行了练习起步。
对于哈斯车队来说，这场雨是一个特别的打击，因为本周末它带来了顶级车队尝试的'翻转'后翼版本，但未能使用。
车队们期待练习二时的天气会好转。
detailEn: Heavy rain meant Formula 1's Las Vegas Grand Prix got off to a bizarre start with no actual laptimes set at all in the first of Thursday evening's practice sessions.
Although 17 drivers went out on full wets to explore the conditions, none actual tried a flying lap amid the standing water, frequent aquaplaning and very low temperatures.

Only Haas's new recruit Rafael Camara went out twice, and he and the two Alpines (which did a two lap out/in run right at the end) jointly topped the lap count on a mere two. The Alpines carried out practice starts by themselves at the very end.
The rainout was a particular blow to Haas, as this weekend it has brought its own version of the 'flipping' rear wings tried by the top teams but was unable to use it.
Teams expect the weather to improve for practice two.

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris confident F1 would not "put us at risk" in the Middle East
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯自信F1不会在中东“让我们处于危险之中”
这位麦凯轮车手表示，他对在卡塔尔和阿布扎比赛车没有个人担忧
对于麦凯轮车迷来说，来自沃金克的最新消息，包括车手、赛车、团队策略以及每个周末的赛事
2025年F1冠军兰多·诺里斯表示，他对赛季最后两场中东赛事没有担忧，坚称锦标赛不会让其车手和车队处于危险之中。
在本周末的拉斯维加斯赛事之后，锦标赛将于11月27日至29日移师卡塔尔，然后于12月4日至6日前往阿布扎比。
由于该地区的情况，今年一级方程式不得不调整了赛历，巴林大奖赛被移至马来西亚，沙特阿拉伯大奖赛被取消。如果卡塔尔和阿布扎比的最后两场比赛无法进行，伊莫拉曾被考虑作为替代场地，但现在这一意大利场地已被排除在外。
在周四的拉斯维加斯车手新闻发布会上，当被问及他对前往该地区的担忧时，诺里斯表示他期待这次旅行。
“我只是期待这次旅行。从我的角度来看，我很好。我想问题是，我们是一个大车队。所以更多的是，我的队友们怎么想？我很好，”诺里斯说。
麦克拉伦车手透露，他在赛车周末开始之前就已经前往该地区。
"我下周在巴林有朋友的婚礼。所以目前我计划先去那里，然后去卡塔尔和阿布扎比。所以对我来说，没有问题，"他说。
"我只是不相信这项运动会在这种情况下让我们处于危险之中。MotoGP也去过那里。所以对我来说，没有顾虑。"
MotoGP在本月初在卡塔尔赛车，没有出现任何问题。
诺里斯强调，这个决定影响到的人远不止车手们。
“但是，是的，这不仅仅是我个人的事。我想这涉及到更多的人。是粉丝，是车队人员，”他补充道。
同样出席新闻发布会的凯迪拉克车手瓦尔特里·博塔斯也表示同意。
“我肯定会去那里参赛。没有顾虑，因为，就像兰多说的，如果一级方程式决定我们去那里，他们不会去如果那里没有明确的计划或者不知道那里是否安全，”博塔斯说。
detailEn: Lando Norris confident F1 would not "put us at risk" in the Middle East
The McLaren driver says he has no personal concerns about racing in Qatar and Abu Dhabi
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.
2025 Formula 1 champion Lando Norris says he has no concerns about the final two races of the season in the Middle East, insisting the championship would not put its drivers and teams at risk.
After this weekend's race in Las Vegas, the championship heads to Qatar from 27-29 November and then Abu Dhabi from 4-6 December.

F1 has had to adapt its calendar this year because of the situation in the region, with the Bahrain Grand Prix moved to Malaysia and the Saudi Arabian Grand Prix cancelled. Imola had been considered as a replacement venue if the final two races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi were unable to go ahead, but the Italian venue has now been ruled out.
Asked in the drivers' press conference in Las Vegas on Thursday whether he had any reservations about travelling to the region, Norris said he was looking forward to it.
"I'm just looking forward to it. From my side, I'm fine. I guess the thing is, it's a big team that we travel with. So it's more, what do the rest of my team think? I'm fine," Norris said.
The McLaren driver revealed that he is heading to the region even before the race weekends begin.
"I've my friend's wedding in Bahrain next week. So at the moment I was planning on going there, and then going on to Qatar and then Abu Dhabi. So from my side, not a concern," he said.
"I just don't believe the sport would put us at risk in this kind of situation. MotoGP have also been there. So from my side, no concerns."
MotoGP raced in Qatar earlier this month without any issues.
Norris stressed that the decision affected far more people than the drivers.
"But yeah, it's not about me. I guess it's a lot more people. It's the fans, it's the team personnel," he added.
Cadillac's Valtteri Bottas, who was also in the press conference, agreed.

"I'm going to be racing there for sure. No concerns because, like Lando said, if Formula 1 decides that we're going there, they wouldn't go there if there's not a clear plan or if they didn't know that it's going to be safe," Bottas said.
keyPointsZh: 诺里斯对中东最后两站赛事表示信心
赛事将在卡塔尔和阿布扎比举行
keyPointsEn: Lando Norris is confident about the final two races in the Middle East
The races will be held in Qatar and Abu Dhabi
